title: Nonzero low-degree coefficient arrays
statement: For nonnegative integers $n$ and $\ell$, a nonzero low-degree coefficient array is a function from the subsets of $[n]$ of size at most $\ell$ to $\mathbb F_2$ that is not identically zero.
hypotheses_covered: The coefficient array is not the zero function
